instruction: I have three mountain pictures in my Pictures folder with generic names. Please add the prefix 'Mountain_' to each picture filename to better organize them.

metadata.explanation: Task requires renaming three picture files to add 'Mountain_' prefix. The evaluator lists files starting with 'Mountain_' in /home/user/Pictures and checks if exactly 3 such files exist. This is simpler than the original task which required identifying specific mountains.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts files with 'Mountain_' prefix from /home/user/Pictures directory
Metric correctly compares file count against expected value of 3
Expected value (3 files) matches instruction requirement
Logic will work correctly at runtime with proper error handling
Parameter handling is correct for type='rule' (directly accesses expected.get('expected_count'))
Complete coverage of core requirement: verifies that 3 files with Mountain_ prefix exist
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: Evaluator doesn't verify original files (picture1.jpg, picture2.jpg, picture3.jpg) were actually renamed vs. new files created, but this doesn't prevent semantic verification since the end state is what matters
Minor: Getter accepts any files starting with 'Mountain_', not specifically .jpg files, but task context strongly implies image files
